title: The Art of Noise with Max Headroom - Paranoimia (Official Video)
summary: The official 1986 music video for Paranoimia by Art of Noise featuring the computer-generated TV personality Max Headroom. It is a synth-pop and sampling-era piece of 80s pop culture.
why: HN mentions it mostly as a reference point in Max Headroom threads, as the essential Art of Noise tie-in to that 80s character.

quote.text: you can't talk about Max Headroom without talking about The Art of Noise
